fusions.name: Seam Prying
fusions.desc: Works the spade's corner between the plates and levers them apart, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Plate Ringer
fusions.desc: Swings the flat of the blade in a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it, stunning each enemy for 1 second and leaving it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Revetment
fusions.desc: Packs earth against your armour, raising it by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Trench Plate
fusions.desc: Conjures a cuirass of overlapping spade blades: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
